name: agent-bridge
description: Local Codex ↔ Claude Code messaging with automatic inbox delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Message local Claude Code and Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Lifecycle hooks register a local peer for each Codex thread. Discover peers, send messages by session name, and receive durable inbox messages automatically through Codex's native queue, including while idle.
interface.defaultPrompt: List the live local sessions I can message.
